d:
Enjoy the Extended Cut of the melodious love song - Ishq Di Baajiyaan from the film Soorma. Starring Diljit Dosanjh and Taapsee Pannu, the music of the film has been composed by Shankar Ehsaan Loy and the lyrics penned by Gulzar
Music - Shankar Ehsaan Loy
Lyrics- Gulzar
Singer- Diljit Dosanjh
Additional Vocals – Shankar Mahadevan
Director - Shaad Ali
Produced By - Sony Pictures Networks Productions; Chitrangada Singh & Deepak Singh
